summary: Autocomplete search for tracks, albums, artists and tags
description: Returns autocomplete suggestions for the given prefix across selected entities (tracks, albums, artists, tags). The 'entity' parameter can limit the search to specific entity types. The 'matchcount' flag adds the number of matches per suggestion. Minimum prefix length is 2 characters. The response includes a headers object with status information and a results object with arrays of matches per entity.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback function name; only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return per entity.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' to the response header indicating the total rows without limit/offset.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: String to be searched as a prefix of an entity name. Minimum length is 2 characters.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: List of entity types to search. If omitted, all entities are searched.

parameters.name: matchcount
parameters.description: When true, includes the count of matches for each suggestion. Default is false.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the response, including status, code, error_message, warnings, and results_count.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Contains arrays of matches per requested entity (e.g., tags, artists, albums, tracks). Each array holds objects with 'match' and optionally 'count' fields.

notes: 'entity' must be provided as a repeated query parameter (e.g., entity=tracks&entity=artists) or as a comma‑separated list depending on client implementation.
'matchcount' defaults to false; enabling it adds a 'count' field to each match object.
The API key is passed via the 'client_id' query parameter, hence authType is 'apikey'.
The 'format' parameter defaults to 'json' if omitted.
